name: red-active-pill
description: Caption design from Matthew's older reels: small white words, and the word he is saying sits in a rounded pill in the style's highlight colour (default #C61D3A) that moves word to word. No pop, no colour change on the letters.
plan: a style setting, not a plan entry: "caption_template": "red-active-pill". His reel settings: font Arial Bold, font_size_frac 0.0344, highlight_color #C61D3A, stroke 1, shadow 0, center_y_frac 0.686, max_words 4, max_chars 22, kw_sync_pop false, kw_pop_pct 0, pop_scale 1.
